messages:
Mia M (marketing): Heads-up — target announce publish window is WED 03/10 09:00 PT. Need final changelog + docs links by TUE 17:00 PT. Can eng confirm rollout/canary timing and gating?

Omar (eng): Aligning with that. Changelog PR #482 is the blocker — plan to merge late Tue. Canary window set 09:00-11:00 PT Wed. I'll post exact deploy timestamps.

Kai (docs): I'll stage the docs under the release dir once PR merges. Current draft anchor: /docs/optimizer/3.2-draft. Final URL will be posted here after merge.

Nate (product): Marketing question — do we gate the public post on canary perf (p95 latency)? What's the threshold?

Omar (eng): We're using p95 < 250ms as green. If p95 between 250-350ms we hold and investigate. If >350ms we rollback. Fallback target is model v2. Runbook short: ```if canary.p95 < 250 -> proceed; elif p95 < 350 -> pause + debug; else -> rollback to v2```

Mia M (marketing): Perfect. If a hold/rollback happens we'll pause social/email and update the launch page. Need final screenshots (benchmark graphs) and an export of test queries for the blog. @Lina can you generate assets by Tue 14:00 PT?

Lina (design): Yep — I’ll upload bench images and a 16:9 hero by Tue 15:00 to /drive/marketing/opt32-assets.

Mia M (marketing): For the webinar, planning a 30 min demo + 15 min Q&A Wed 13:00 PT. @Nate you're speaker for product, Omar for infra. Can you both confirm?

Nate (product): Confirmed. I’ll draft the demo script and callouts for the benchmark narrative.

Omar (eng): Confirmed. I’ll prepare a 3-slide infra explainer and a short canary summary.

Mia M (marketing): Inbound routing — set lead-form tag to "release-optimizer-3.2" and route to SDR queue A. Also add utm_campaign param.

Sasha (sales): Confirmed. We'll add routing and tagging. Using utm_campaign=opt32-launch and tag=release-optimizer-3.2.

Kai (docs): Posting reminders: please do not link to docs draft in public channels. I'll paste final canonical URL here when it’s live: https://docs.redwood.com/optimizer/3.2 (pending merge).

Omar (eng): Merging changelog PR Tue 2026-03-10T00:45Z PT. Deploy job will run after merge. deploy-bot: Canary started 2026-03-10T16:00ZZ.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% (progress updates).

Mia M (marketing): Quick checklist for engineering: 1) Confirm changelog link 2) Confirm docs URL 3) Post canary status here at start and end 4) Provide final perf numbers (p50/p95/p99).

Omar (eng): Will do. Posting numbers in-thread at canary end.

Mia M (marketing): If we hit rollback, marketing holds announcements and we coordinate a follow-up status note. If go-green, we push blog, social, and email immediately after canary success.

Kai (docs): Final docs URL now live: https://docs.redwood.com/optimizer/3.2 — updated anchors and changelog references.

Omar (eng): Canary finished 2026-03-10T18:05ZZ status: success. Perf snapshot: p50=48ms, p95=198ms, p99=412ms (tail due to one noisy host, mitigated before cutover). All canary checks passed.

deploy-bot: Canary finished 2026-03-10T18:05ZZ status: success (automated).

Mia M (marketing): :tada: Great! Posting announcement now. Blog URL: https://redwood.com/blog/optimizer-3-2-release — social drafts are live in /drive/marketing/social-opt32.

Sasha (sales): SDR routing live. Leads will be tagged "release-optimizer-3.2" and queued to SDR A.

Lina (design): Assets uploaded and linked in the post.

Nate (product): Webinar invite sent, calendar updated.

Mia M (marketing): Small follow-up: please add any postmortem notes or perf regressions to the release thread in #postmortems if anything odd shows up in first 24h. React with :white_check_mark: once you're set.

Omar (eng): :white_check_mark:

Kai (docs): :white_check_mark:

Lina (design): :white_check_mark:

Sasha (sales): :white_check_mark:

Mia M (marketing): Thanks all — closing coordination thread.
